Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Cyclooctaamylose is introduced as an interfacial regulator that accelerates zincate desolvation and promotes uniform zinc nucleation and growth in alkaline zinc–iron flow batteries. This interfacial engineering suppresses dendrite formation and enables simultaneously high power density and high areal capacity, addressing a key bottleneck in aqueous flow battery performance.

Nature | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a halogen-free kosmotropic/polar anion/nucleophilic electrolyte framework that stabilizes hypervalent iodine via Nuc–I⁺–Nuc halogen bonds instead of interhalogen complexation, enabling reversible four-electron iodine conversion in aqueous Zn–I₂ and Al–I₂ batteries. This mechanistic shift offers a safer, high-energy route for aqueous multi-electron iodine chemistry.
